parent_objective: post-PPO protected-key source projection with trajectory action anchor retention

public_gates: full public replay gates only after exact source and row16 gates pass
protected key gate only after exact source and row16 gates pass
behavior retention only after proof gates pass
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M258
do not promote projection without exact source and public proof gates
do not run full public gates if exact source or row16 gate fails
do not alter trajectory anchor format
hypothesis: Adding the M235 trajectory action anchor to the M256 protected-source projection can preserve row16 closed-loop behavior while still repairing protected-key source loss from M254 raw PPO.
success_criteria: projection reduces protected-key source loss versus M254 raw
at least one projected/interpolated alpha has M223 source delta < 0, aggregate M232 delta <= +1e-8, and protected-key source delta <= +1e-8 versus M253
at least one exact-gated alpha preserves M183/M170 row16 normal success and margin
only row16/exact-gated candidates advance to full replay protected-key and behavior gates
failure_criteria: trajectory-anchored projection cannot restore protected-key source without losing M223 improvement
all projected/interpolated candidates fail exact source gate
exact-gated candidates still fail M183/M170 row16
candidate exact-gates and row16-gates but fails broader public proof retention

commands.name: m258_projection
commands.command: Run protected-key source actor-coupling projection from M254 raw PPO with M253 snippet anchor and M235 trajectory anchor, then exact-source and row16 gate before broader public gates.

decision_rule: M258 may only promote a candidate if exact source, row16, full public replay, protected-key, behavior, and research-validator gates all pass.
next_blocker: If M258 fails, audit whether trajectory anchor weight or projection scope conflicts with protected-source repair.
